source.cite: T.O. 33K3-4-911-1, Calibration Procedure for Synthesized Signal Generator 6060 A/AN (Fluke), 30 April 2017 (GIDEP)
source.note: Points and limits are the document's own tables. Its measuring instruments (53132A, E4418B + 8482A, N5530SE26, E4440A, E8257D, FMAV) are replaced by the lab bench (8902A, 96270A + NRP40T, 8563E); each replacement is flagged UNVERIFIED on the point. The Calibration Performance Table is "Not Required"; Appendix A (reference oscillator adjustment) is not built.

discrepancies: The document measures with instruments this bench does not have; the 8902A, 96270A + NRP40T and 8563E replace them (see the flags). The deviation-meter checks (4.6) and the reference-oscillator frequency (4.1.5) need a signal generator / counter that this program does not drive: those readings are typed.
Table 2 prints 100.00000 to 199.99999 MHz in steps of 11.11111 MHz; the last row is printed 199.99999 (not 199.99999 + rounding): used as printed.
Spur frequencies of Table 12 are printed as absolute frequencies; those within 1 MHz of the carrier are measured as offsets (both sides), those within 1 kHz are typed.
The document recalls stored state 9,8 in 4.3 and gives no carrier for 4.3, 4.9; 300 MHz and 520 MHz are used.

Table 1 also lists display range, amplitude, internal modulation, AM / FM accuracy, deviation meter, spectral purity and residual AM / FM: each is covered by a test above; the 8902A frequency counter covers the display range (+/-1 count).

sections.title: Preliminary: power-on self test
sections.setup: Switch the 6060A POWER on with the RF output OFF. The built-in self test runs (about 5 seconds); if it passes the generator goes to the Instrument Preset state. Warm up one hour with RF OFF (the reference oscillator needs 24 hours powered).

points.description: Power-on self test passed
flags: Prompt-based pass / fail: the document says only that the self test takes about 5 s. The reading is 1 for passed and 0 for failed. UNVERIFIED: no remote self-test result is confirmed.

sections.title: Frequency accuracy
sections.setup: 4.1.5: 6060A rear 10 MHz IN/OUT to the counter, REF INT. Then the counter's 10 MHz reference is applied (REF EXT) and the 8902A (with the same reference) reads the RF output.

points.description: Reference oscillator 10 MHz IN/OUT frequency (counter), 9 999 940 to 10 000 060 Hz
points.manual_prompt: Read the frequency counter on the 6060A rear 10 MHz IN/OUT (REF INT) and type the frequency in Hz (limits 9 999 940 to 10 000 060 Hz).
flags: Typed reading: the document measures it with the Agilent 53132A counter; no counter is driven by this program. The limits are the printed 9,999,940 Hz to 10.000 060 MHz (+/-6 ppm, Table 1).
